goal: Complete Switch 1 of issue #1403 by making 'Agent work contract' a required status context on main and committing the two artefacts that must move with it: the mirror of the required list that the guarded-merge pre-flight reads when it cannot read branch protection, and the pinned floor in scripts/check-required-checks-preflight.mjs that defends the list against shrinking. Switch 2, retiring the legacy objects: alias, stays closed and is not touched.
dispatcher: repo session, owner request 2026-09-08 (five oldest non-orchestrator issues)
prohibited_actions: Do not hand-edit branch protection; the live change is made only by scripts/update-required-checks.mjs, which refuses every removal and rename and never touches strict.
Do not hand-edit docs/verification/main-required-status-checks.json; it is rewritten by that tool from its own post-write readback, and a hand-edited mirror is a mirror of nothing.
Do not change strict; it stays false under the owner ruling on issue #1286.
Do not remove or reorder any existing entry in PINNED_REQUIRED_CONTEXTS; the pin exists to make shrinking fail CI, so it may only grow.

Do not touch Switch 2. The legacy objects: alias stays live while any open claim still uses it, because such a claim is read as a WRITE and retiring it early would let a second writer start on work already in flight.
Do not let the proposed head supply the list its own mirror is judged against; the pinned floor is read from origin/main only.
assumptions: The activation gate in config/agent-work-contract-activation.json is met: enforced mode began 2026-09-07T21:26:45Z and this change was made after 2026-09-08T21:26:45Z, a full day later.

A pull request that legitimately FAILS the newly required check is the gate working, not a reason to defer it. Both such pull requests open at the time of the switch fail for stale branch evidence their own authors refresh, not for anything the check gets wrong.
The pinned floor may grow without weakening it, because every test that uses it either compares the committed mirror to it or feeds it in as a trusted origin/main list.

Generation 4 exists because the independent review of generation 3 found that growing the pin deadlocked the guarded merge: the pre-flight runs from the head's tree, so the head's grown pin was judged against origin/main's not-yet-grown mirror and refused the very commit that would update it. The fix reads the floor from origin/main's own copy of the pre-flight source, so the test file joins the writable set. No branch-protection setting changed between generation 3 and generation 4.
stop_conditions: Stop if the readback after the live change does not show exactly twelve contexts with strict still false.
Stop if any context present before the change is absent after it.
Stop if the preflight test suite does not pass with the grown pin.
Stop if the pinned floor read from origin/main does not refuse a head that drops a name origin/main still pins.
